prose: TSMC reported record third-quarter results: revenue up 50.9% to $46.36B and net income up 68.7% to $23.7B, both above estimates, a sixth straight record profit quarter. Operating margin reached 58.7%, above guidance.
It guides fourth-quarter revenue to $52.3B-$54.3B, about 58% higher than a year earlier at the midpoint, driven by AI chip demand.
highlights: Q3 revenue $46.36B, net income $23.7B, both beat.
